referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Fit This website in London, England uses full-width action photograph carrying an all-caps community statement. Navigation is compact dark header with membership action. Its page moves through action opening, training, classes and recovery choices, local gym story, membership options, personal training image band, member voices, team, trial close, with three photographed offerings followed by strong pricing or membership panels. documentary gym photography with dark overlays. Transferable mechanics are purple membership field, three photo offer panels, local team close. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
